verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents a nightly refresh for each connection, with a configurable refresh time, and describes the model as 'rebuilt overnight off the close', plus on-demand Sync now and re-import of past months. Nothing in the evidence shows a per-source 'last synced' timestamp, so only half the story is evidenced. missing for 10: per-source last-synced timestamp/status display, detailed schedule documentation tied to the close, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, each connected source shows when it last synced, and data refreshes on a documented schedule after the close

citations.quote: change the time a connection refreshes each night
One live model of the company, rebuilt overnight off the close
